bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to housing; appropriating money for a grant to CAPI USA.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. TRANSFER AND APPROPRIATION; CAPI USA HOMEOWNERSHIP EDUCATION AND FINANCIAL COUNSELING PROGRAM.

(a) $200,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $200,000 in fiscal year 2027 are transferred from the general fund to the housing development fund. This is a onetime transfer.

(b) $200,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $200,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the housing development fund to the commissioner of the Housing Finance Agency for a grant to CAPI USA to administer the CAPI USA homeownership education and financial counseling programming. This is a onetime appropriation.
